subject: Invoice split and cost-center mapping for Aurelius Health PO
messages:

Cc: ap@aureliushealth.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice & PO: split invoicing across Aurelius entities

Hi Kimberly,

Attached is PO #AH-6678 for the upcoming Redwood pilot. We need the invoice structured so charges are allocated across two legal entities: Aurelius Health, Inc. (US) and Aurelius Health EU Ltd. (Ireland). Key asks:

- Single billing deliverable (one PDF preferred) but with discrete invoice sections for each legal entity so our AP can auto-apply to the right ledgers.
- Each section must include the entity name, VAT/Tax ID, billing address, and a mapping back to our internal cost center (see sample CSV attached).
- Please show tax (VAT) as separate lines for the EU entity.
- Include PO AH-6678 and our internal cost center codes in the invoice lines.

Attachments: PO_Aurelius_2026.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)

Can Redwood confirm this layout is supported and the expected timeline for issuing split invoices? Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Santos
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurelius Health
procurement@aureliushealth.com

Date: 2026-12-10T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & PO: split invoicing across Aurelius entities

Elena,

Thanks for the PO and clear asks — we can support split invoicing and the single-PDF-with-sections approach. A few quick confirmations so our billing and finance teams can generate the correct artifacts:

- Please confirm the exact legal-entity display name and tax ID for the EU entity (we'll need the VAT registration number).
- Do you want two invoice numbers (one per legal entity) or one invoice with two numbered sections? Our accounting prefers separate invoice numbers (easier for AR postings), but we can do either.
- Confirm preferred remit instructions for each entity if bank accounts differ.

Tentative next steps: I'll loop in Marissa (Finance) to propose an invoice template and allocation table. Ben from Sales Ops will help with PO matching and HubSpot tagging. If you have the cost center CSV, please attach it or send a Drive link.

Would you be open to a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow afternoon?

Best,

Kimberly Park

Subject: RE: Invoice & PO: split invoicing across Aurelius entities

Kimberly / team,

Thanks Elena — we've reviewed the CSV. Finance can produce a consolidated PDF that contains two discrete invoice documents inside (one per legal entity) and issue separate invoice numbers for AR posting. High-level notes from our side:

- Invoice numbering: RED-INV-2026-6001 (Aurelius Health, Inc. - US) and RED-INV-2026-6002 (Aurelius Health EU Ltd. - IE).
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless you request otherwise.
- VAT handling: EU invoice will list taxable base and VAT line item. We'll include a VAT summary block to satisfy your AP validation.
- Cost center allocation: We'll include a table on each invoice section that maps invoice line items to your provided cost center codes. If a single line item spans multiple cost centers, we can split the line into sub-lines with allocated amounts.

Next steps for the pilot:
1) Kimberly: confirm invoice numbers and final PO labels you want printed on each section.
2) Elena/AP: confirm Bank/IBAN details in the CSV and whether Aurelius AP wants the PDF as one file or two separate PDFs uploaded to your portal.
3) Finance (Marissa): I will attach our proposed "rdw-invoice-split-template.xlsx" and a sample mock invoice by end of day tomorrow for review.

Attachment: rdw-invoice-split-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 32KB)

If you prefer a short call, happy to join — otherwise I'll push the mock to the Drive link and ping you when it's ready.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

- Including a cost-center allocation table on each invoice and splitting any multi-cost-center lines into sub-lines to preserve traceability.
- Showing VAT lines on the EU invoice and the VAT summary block for your AP.
- Marking the invoices with the PO labels AH-6678-US and AH-6678-EU.

Marissa will upload the mock invoices to the Drive folder and tag the HubSpot deal record. Ben will ensure PO matching is set up so payments apply correctly in our billing system.

Planned timeline:
- Mock invoices in Drive by EOD 2026-12-15.
- Final invoices issued once we get your PO acknowledgements and bank remit confirmation (target 2026-12-17).

If that works, no call needed — otherwise I'm available 12/15 1:00–3:00pm PT for a quick alignment.

Thanks again,
